name: Muesli
author: ssobhani
description: Local AI meeting notes: call detection, recording state, and naming from the bar. Talks to muesli-daemon through muesli-cli.

barWidget.description: Mountain-ridge icon that asks to record detected Zoom/Discord calls, shows a live timer while recording, progress while wrapping up, and a panel to name the meeting afterwards. Left = panel · right = start/stop recording · middle = open notes.

schema.label: Show the recording timer in the bar
muesli-cli command
schema.description: Name on PATH or an absolute path (~ is expanded).
